name: odoo-connect
description: Community-developed plugin for Odoo, connecting Odoo SaaS securely to ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Community-developed plugin for Odoo, built for secure everyday work.
interface.longDescription: An independent, community-developed connector for Odoo SaaS. Work with contacts, CRM opportunities, quotations, sales orders, and invoices from ChatGPT and Codex through a secure OAuth-protected MCP gateway. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Odoo S.A.
defaultPrompt: Show my newest CRM opportunities in Odoo.
Find overdue customer invoices in Odoo.
Preview a safe update to an Odoo contact.
